Catch-all for v1 paths Next does not serve. Forwards the request unchanged to the Express runtime when RUNTIME_API_URL is set (lib/runtime/forward-to-runtime.ts), otherwise answers the JSON 404. It authorizes nothing itself and needs nothing: the runtime authenticates the API key on every forwarded request and serves the key's own project (server/routes/dynamic.ts, server/routes/v2.ts), behind the serving gate (server/lib/serving-gate.ts). The only header it adds, x-backenly-internal, is read solely to skip traffic recording and to stop a forward loop; it grants no access.
